regulations.notes: Edwards is an unincorporated community in Eagle County. As of late 2025, Eagle County has declined to impose strict STR licensing and takes a 'light-touch' data-collection approach. No county-wide STR license is currently required for unincorporated Eagle County areas including Edwards. This may change if the county adopts a full licensing ordinance.
regulations.pending_legislation: Eagle County considering full STR licensing ordinance
